presentation.speaker: frank_doyle
presentation.title: Insurance claim dispute
lines: The insurer disputes a $3,200 accident repair on one of your rental cars. Pay it yourself, fight it with a lawyer, or settle for half.

choices.label: Pay the repair yourself
choices.outcome: You pay the full $3,200 and the matter closes.

choices.label: Fight the dispute
choices.outcome: A $350 lawyer; about half the time you win and pay nothing more.

choices.label: Settle for half
choices.outcome: You pay half the repair and move on.
